messages:
maya: Quick proposal  instead of ad-hoc triage calls, let's adopt a one-line decision gate on each post-launch ticket so reviewers can route instantly. I sketched a tiny checklist that should live in the ticket body.

ajay: love it. deterministic rules save cycles. if we can make labels auto-apply from the fields even better.

courtney: here's a compact gate we can paste into the ticket template: 

````
Post-launch decision gate:
- Severity (choose): P0/P1/P2/P3
- Regression? (yes/no) -> if yes, bump one level
- Customer impact? (none/enterprise/major-cohort)
- Dev effort estimate: <1d / 1-3d / >3d
- Delivery lane: patch / fast-win / next-wave
- Acceptance criteria: metric or concrete UX example
- Rollout: canary-window + smoke script path + rollback criterion
````

courtney: Suggested routing rule: if Severity <= P1 OR Customer impact=enterprise -> lane=patch. If effort <=3d and Severity=P2 -> fast-win. Else next-wave.

ben: add: any DB migration or stateful change requires a "safety owner" field and an explicit rollback command. Also regressions touching core paths auto-assign to SRE for review.

sara: i'll provide a smoke script template and a 30-min observation checklist. also propose a standard canary label `postlaunch/canary` that our deploy bot watches for.

oliver: for product dev planning, split next-wave into "spike" (3d) + implementation. if the spike shows <=3d work we can promote it to fast-win mid-cycle. keeps options open.

dena: if we mark a ticket lane=patch and customer=enterprise we need a one-line ETA template to send CS. i'll draft a short message product can reuse.

lydia: i'll take a quick 1-day spike on the largest enhancement to break it into sub-deliverables. if it fits the fast-win pattern we can pull it into the buffer.

maya: Ops: can we automate label apply? Example: if ticket includes "Severity:P0" label -> auto-add `patch/urgent`. Ajay, can eng infra help?

ajay: yep i'll file an infra task. we can map ticket fields to labels and surface missing fields as a blocker on PR.

release-bot: Canary helper: when PR body includes `canary-window: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC` and label `postlaunch/canary` I will reserve next slot and reply with reservation id. Next slot available: 2026-05-20 08:00-09:00 UTC.

maya: Final: I'm going to add the gate to the ticket template and a small automation ticket to map fields->labels. Action items: 1) Courtney add gate text to templates. 2) Sara publish smoke/rollback templates. 3) Ajay open infra task for label automation. 4) Owners add the gate fields + acceptance criteria to each open post-launch ticket by EOD. If anyone objects to a lane assignment call it out in-thread within 2h. :white_check_mark:
